simple.meaning: אֲרוֹדִי (ʼĂrôwdîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Arodite or descendant of Arod.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲרוֹדִי (H722) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:16, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲרוֹדִי (H722) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲרוֹדִי (H722) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲרוֹדִי (ʼĂrôwdîy) / H722 is traced through Genesis 46:16, Numbers 26:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: an Arodite or descendant of Arod
definitions.full: H722. Arodi אֲרוֺדִי adjective, of a people with article as proper name collective, ׳הָא ׳מִשְׁפ Num 26:17 ; without article as proper name = אֲרוֺד Gen 46:16 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
